text:
Sana: FYI we started getting p95/p99 complaints right after runtime rollout (v2026.03.15-rc1). Support cases INC-5213, INC-5214. Customers seeing API 200 but slow tails — anyone on call?
Jim: I'm on it, grabbing metrics. Which cohort/region is affected?
Sana: Mostly us-west and some eu-west customers on Dedicated. P95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~380ms on text.generate. P99 spiked to ~1.4s.
Lina: Looking at traces I see increased queueing on the worker hotpath after the kernel-selector change. Quick log sample: ```worker_id=wk-33 host=gpu-6 queue_ms=320 batch_size=1 kernel=matmul_v2```
Kevin: Noted. Did we change kernel defaults in the rollout? That was part of the runtime change, right?
Lina: Yes — kernel selection now prefers matmul_v2 on Ampere for shapes <512. Hypothesis: matmul_v2 has higher cold-path overhead and degrades small-batch latency.
Jim: Repro steps I used against prod canary (short prompt ~20 tokens at 20 RPS):
```seq 1 50 | xargs -P20 -I{} curl -s 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-7b","input":"hi"}'```
Sana: Can we roll back kernel selector or force the older kernel for the affected region? Customers are hitting SLA alerts.
Lina: I can push a hotpatch to override kernel selector to matmul_v1 per host group. Need prod write access — @Kevin can you approve?
Kevin: Approved. @Lina proceed; coordinate with @oncall-sre to avoid rollout turbulence.
oncall-sre: I'll drain and apply to 10% of hosts first, monitor p95. Add a quick healthcheck for inference latency to the deploy.
Lina: Hotpatch deployed to 10% of us-west hosts. Early metrics: patched nodes p95 down from 380ms -> 150ms. P99 still elevated on remaining hosts.
Jim: Nice. Can we ramp to 60% then full if stable? Support — please ping impacted customers with an ETA.
Sana: Notifying customers: 'we're rolling a fix; expected improvement within 30m; we'll update' :email:  
Kevin: After we stabilize, add a canary test to detect kernel-selection tail regressions — synthetic short-prompt RPS test in the canary perf-suite.
Lina: Agreed. I'll add the synthetic test and file a postmortem. Tentative root cause: matmul_v2 cold-path overhead for small batches + selector default change. Filing ENG-7232.
Sana: Thanks all. I'll keep SLA owners updated and close the loop once full rollout completes.
